outcome.technical: tools/affected.py (+90/-0 lines) gets two listing modes, both printing one suite path per line and executing nothing, matching the contract derive-phase-gate.py's meta.phaseGate.derived.listing reads: `--list-all` lists every suite file under plugins/audit/tests (read off _output.py_files, names starting with 'test', so a helper like _harness.py is never printed as a suite); `--list-related <path>...` reuses select() unchanged (importers' suites plus every TREE_SCANNERS suite once any .py is touched) and widens to the full listing the moment select() returns full=True - the same 'an unrecognised path selects everything' rule, now also the listing's own fallback. Both run before any --json/--base/git-diff handling in main(), so neither needs a git repo. New helpers _suite_path/_all_suite_paths/_related_suite_paths; a third '# --- the CLI entry point ---' section marker added ahead of main() because the file crossed 800 lines (test__deps.py's tn0 caught the gap: 827 lines, 2 markers, needs >=3). Tests added as inline selftest cases a16/a17 (TDD: written first, run red - NameError on the missing helpers/flags with a0-a15 still green - then the implementation added until 26/26 passed), driving main() end-to-end via contextlib.redirect_stdout rather than asserting on an internal return value, since the contract is what gets PRINTED. Measured: `python3 tools/affected.py --list-all` real 1.10s (155 suite paths); `python3 tools/affected.py --list-related plugins/audit/scripts/governance/run-test-gate.py` real 5.38s (12 suite paths; slower because _reverse_imports() builds the whole import graph through _deps.import_graph()) - both far below the ~505-592s phase-gate durationMs P125.8 measured from the evidence ledger's 12 newest P125 task rows. NOT WIRED, and said rather than built unwired: the brief asks to record these as meta.phaseGate.derived.listing.all/.related 'through the verb that writes meta (no hand edit of docs/audit/)', and no such verb exists in this codebase - plugins/audit/scripts/manifest/_manifest_phases.py and plugins/audit/scripts/governance/derive-phase-gate.py only READ/VALIDATE meta.phaseGate (grepped scripts/manifest and scripts/governance for a writer: none). docs/audit/audit-plan.json is outside this task's files and hand-editing it is explicitly forbidden, so the task gate for this and every other P125 task stays at gateBasis phase-no-spelling and keeps running the full ~505s gate - unchanged from P125.8's own measurement, for the same reason P125.8 named: 'the lever needs a path-scoped spelling this repo does not record.' A follow-up task needs either a manifest-writing verb (audit-task.py or a new one) that can set meta.phaseGate.derived.{listing,spelling,runner,mode}, or an explicit, reviewed hand-edit of docs/audit/audit-plan.json's meta block naming these two listing commands plus a path-scoped spelling for tools/sweep-selftests.py (P125.8's other NOT DONE item - that file is outside this task's files too). Full sweep after the fix: 334/334 files ok, 16009 cases, exit 0 (one earlier run in this shared tree showed test__deps.py and test_drive_phase.py failing: test__deps.py for the missing section marker, fixed; test_drive_phase.py's failure did not reproduce on a clean re-run of that file alone, 253/253, and that file is not among this task's files).
